sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Our position
move.body: Thank you for your quote. Please review our counter-offer.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We have carefully reviewed your counter-offer and welcome the proposal for a 24-month contract, which provides valuable stability for both sides. For our primary Angebot, we can present a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

However, as a family-run business, extending payment terms to 60 days is not feasible for us, but we are prepared to compromise at 45 days. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €52.00 per unit, with a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Our foundry takes immense pride in the long-standing relationship we have built with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over the years, and we always seek to work together in good partnership.

For our part, we have already made a significant concession to reach €52.20 for the 60-day payment term you requested. Consequently, our offer remains a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. We must maintain our current position and ask that we continue to negotiate constructively. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We deeply value our shared history and look forward to finding a good way forward together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

As a family-run business that values our long-standing partnership, we expect constructive negotiations rather than steps in the wrong direction. We have already reached our limit for the 60-day payment term and must firmly hold our offer at €52.20.

Our Angebot stands at a price of €52.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

It is always a privilege to serve your company, and we look forward to continuing our collaboration on solid ground.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
